title: notary-request
description: The locked notary#3 v1.3 emit record. One JSON object per shortfall/staleness/tie event, appended as JSON lines to a CI artifact the filer consumes. Canonical copy lives in confluent-trust (architecture R4-Q4); other repos vendor it under a byte-identity CI check. Dedupe key = (claim_id, source_sha, reason, artifact_digest).

ledger_version.description: PA is computed against this ledger version; an emitter rejects a claim_id that does not resolve here (R3, no phantom ids).

source_ref.description: owner/repo@path to the source the claim lives in (a real, resolvable path).

source_sha.description: The 40-hex pinned sha the gate evaluated.

artifact_digest.description: null EXCEPT artifact_tie_mismatch, where it is the shipped-bytes digest.

current_pa.description: null for artifact_tie_mismatch (the shipped thing is not the proven thing); a 0-2 integer otherwise.

pinning_consumer.description: The consumers pinning this claim; [] for an unpinned critical claim, non-empty when the reason involves a pin.
